fusions.name: Hobbling Jab
fusions.desc: A low stab that deals 5 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 20% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Road's End
fusions.desc: Thrusts at a target up to 8 tiles away for 26 damage that ignores armour, rising to 2 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Lance the Blister
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Every Mile Counted

riders.text: and you arrive with the opening already chosen
and the thrust starts before your feet stop

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. At bronze your movement speed rises 5%, at silver your critical hit chance rises 5%, and at gold your attack speed rises 8%.
